articles.title: Samsung Wallet plans stablecoin support in digital payments expansion
articles.snippet: Samsung Electronics plans to add stablecoin support to Samsung Wallet, expanding its mobile payments and rewards platform to include digital assets.

articles.title: Samsung Wallet Will Add Stablecoin Support, Including USDC
articles.snippet: Samsung showed a wallet mockup holding Circle's USDC at Galaxy Unpacked. But details are scarce.

articles.title: EU Names Justin Sun's HTX in Russia Sanctions, Two Months After UK
articles.snippet: The 21st package stops short of a full asset freeze for HTX, which it accused of "significantly frustrating" its Russia measures.
